header.starBody: The Human Box is free and open source. A star helps other people find it.
header.starAria: Star The Human Box on GitHub
header.tickTip: Simulation tick {tick}. 600 ticks are one in-world day. {days} days have passed.
header.eraBody: Shapes resources and how people behave.
header.statsBody: Population graphs, births and deaths, and lineage growth over time.
header.civBody: Eras, governments, religions, buildings, books, art, and headlines.
header.searchBody: Search everyone, alive or dead, by name, thought, lineage, or discovery.
header.chroniclesBody: The history of this world, written from what has happened.
header.moreBody: Find a tool, save the world, focus filters, and view options.
header.settingsBody: Language, display, performance and your world.
header.worldPanelBody: History, lineages, and the event log.

updates.packagedOnly: only available in the packaged app

language.title: Interface language
language.desc: Menus, tooltips and settings. Names and everything the world writes stay as they are. Changing it reloads the game; your world is saved first.
language.failed: could not save the world first; the language was not changed
language.contribute: Missing your language? Translations are plain files in the repository, and new ones are welcome.

display.photoModeDesc: Hide every panel and the dock for clean screenshots. Press Esc or hover the top edge to get the header back.
display.headlineTickerDesc: A scrolling strip of births, deaths and discoveries at the top.
display.autoFollowDesc: Follow a different person every few seconds. Click anyone to stop.

accessibility.colorBlindDesc: Red-green safe colors for tribes, seasons and status markers.

performance.lowPerfAuto: On automatically for this device. Lower frame rate and resolution, fewer effects.
performance.lowPerfDesc: Lower frame rate and resolution, fewer effects. Reloads the game; your world is saved first.
performance.backgroundDesc: Your world keeps living while this tab is hidden or in the background. Uses more battery.

help.tourDesc: A short walkthrough of the map, the dock and the panels.
help.nerdStatsDesc: Tick counter, connection status and build details in the header.

web.note: The web game runs and saves entirely in this browser. It never connects to a hosted simulation API. For the full native game, download the desktop app.
web.recoveryNote: Reset and unreadable worlds are kept here. A restore is checked before it replaces your active save.
web.checkpointFailed: the current world could not be saved first
web.resetBody:
Your current world is kept in recovery saves.

Use “export save” first if you also want a file you can move.
web.restoreBody:
Restore the recovery from tick {tick}.

It is checked before it becomes active, and the recovery copy stays available.
web.deleteBody: The recovery from tick {tick} is deleted for good.

desktop.exportWorldDesc: Save a portable copy of the current world.
desktop.newWorldDesc: The current world is archived first.
desktop.resetDone: new world started; the previous world was archived
desktop.runsNatively: Your world runs natively on this computer.
desktop.tickNote: Lower is a faster world and more CPU. Default 100 ms.
desktop.capacityNote: Natural births stop at this size; you can still add people yourself. 500 suits the default speed, 1,000+ needs a fast machine. Applies after restart.
desktop.autoUpdateDesc: Check for new versions and offer to install them.
desktop.launchAtSignInDesc: Open The Human Box when you log in.
desktop.startHiddenDesc: Start in the tray without opening a window.
desktop.pauseWhenHiddenDesc: Stop drawing while the window is minimized. Saves CPU.
desktop.moveNote: Moving saves the world and copies the whole worlds folder first. The old folder stays as a backup.
desktop.moveBody:
Move active storage to {target}.

The simulation saves and restarts. The current folder is kept as a backup, and the destination must not already contain a worlds folder.
desktop.moved: worlds moved safely; the previous folder is kept at {path}
desktop.alreadyActive: this is already the active save folder
desktop.pickFailed: could not choose a save folder: {error}
desktop.openWorldsFailed: could not open the worlds folder: {error}
desktop.openLogsFailed: could not open the logs folder: {error}
desktop.restartNote: Tick changes apply after a restart.
desktop.launchFailed: saved, but could not update launch at sign-in: {error}
